paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.39% on average, with FTSE 100 strongest (+0.36%) and Hang Seng weakest (-1.26%). Brent crude changed +0.35% to 96.16. Gold changed -0.04% to 3,883.8999. Bitcoin changed -4.28% to 68,286.0312. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.154%, a relative move of +1.00%. Among the firms tracked, 3i Group (-2.40%) and Freeport-McMoRan (-2.00%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: Amazon revives deal with troubled data centre venture backed by Rick Perry (FT Companies). Tech giant agrees to be Fermi’s anchor tenant after failed talks and boardroom turmoil sent data centre group’s shares south Deals and capital markets: Anthropic’s Amodei ‘not super fussed’ about market turmoil ahead of IPO (FT Markets). AI lab’s chief executive brushes off tech stock turbulence less than a week before planned $1.5tn listing Central banks and macro: German coalition disagreements hold up ECB jobs deal (FT World). Chancellor and his finance minister have yet to agree on a candidate for one of three central bank executive board vacancies Central banks and macro: Don’t scoff at the dangers of tokenisation (FT Markets). The obvious response is to create better cyber defences and central bank safety nets for hyper-liquid, high-speed shocks Geopolitics and trade: Global oil markets swing to surplus as Gulf shipments rebound (FT World). IEA analysts warn it will take months to rebuild stockpiles depleted by US-Iran war
